what: Plan treats `wrapper_rc==2` as post-launch validation failure and maps it to non-health policy plus tests
scenario_or_breakage: In `launch-cursor-ci.sh`, `launch-codex-ci.sh`, and `launch-claude-ci.sh` the normal path ends with `exit 0` (see `exit 0` near each file tail); `exit 2` is only `die()` / argv validation (`launch-cursor-ci.sh:33-36`). suggested_fix: Align the policy with real `wrapper_rc` semantics: either redefine the guard to use `LAUNCHER_EXIT` plus sidecar/classifier output for “unusable tool output”, or change launchers to exit non-zero for the intended validation failures and only then treat as `other`; update tests accordingly.
